edition.title: Research Roundup: Publications by CHPS Faculty
edition.intro:
Students at the College of Health Professions and Sciences benefit from faculty who conduct research into a broad number of health and wellness topics, discovering new insights and creating innovation that impacts our communities and generations to come.

UCF has a Carnegie Foundation designation for very high research activity. Below is a collection of CHPS faculty peer-reviewed publications from January through June 2025.
edition.legend: Bolded names denote CHPS faculty. ** Denotes graduate students. * Denotes undergraduate students.
